decision_authority: explicit_user_promotion after book_aggregation_risk_r1_20261112 verdict ADOPT_AGGREGATION_ONLY (OOS read 2026-11-13)

rule.net_target: per instrument, sum of the signed positions of its active sleeves: MNQ = S01 + S02 + S03, MGC = S05 + S06, MBT = S07 + S08 + S09; S04 shadow excluded
rule.sizing: unchanged lock sizing: 1 contract per sleeve, S01 native 1-4 contracts (0.5 % risk on 50 000 USD)
rule.orders: only the delta between the capped net target and the account position; vote changes at the open of the next minute; S01 stop and target as independent resting stop/limit orders whose quantity is the effect of the S01 exit on the capped net target, recomputed every minute
rule.caps: Topstep lots: micro MNQ/MGC = 0.1 lot, MBT = 1 lot; Combine 50K 5 lots; XFA 2 lots below 1 500 USD balance, 3 lots from 1 500 to 2 000, 5 above, tier read on the previous end-of-session balance
rule.cap_policy: an event that would exceed a cap is reduced to the maximum allowed; open positions are never cut because of a cap; on any later event of the instrument the position moves towards the desired net within the caps, including an exit that frees room (catch-up buy/sell)
rule.overlays: none: no daily stop, no MBT net cap, no volatility scaling, no profit lock (all rejected)

open_points: 1 MBT = 1 lot is a cautious reading of Topstep documentation, to confirm in TopstepX Risk Settings
the lock daily PnL drops MGC/MBT sessions absent from the MNQ calendar (-509 USD on 2024-01 -> 2026-03); correction requires a new versioned lock
